caption: The drawing depicts four mortar and pestle sets arranged side by side against a plain, light beige background. Each mortar and pestle differs in color, shape, and texture. The first set on the left is predominantly red with a cylindrical, footed mortar and a slightly rounded pestle, both featuring carved rings around them. The second set is brown with a darker, more conical mortar that has pronounced horizontal grooves, and the pestle is positioned diagonally, appearing robust and simple in form. The third set is a light tan color with a rounded, bulbous mortar featuring a thick lip at the top, and the pestle is lighter in hue, also displayed at a diagonal angle. The fourth and final set is green with faded gold details; the mortar is tall, flared, and raised on a footed base, while its pestle is shorter, thicker, and placed leaning towards the right side. All objects are rendered in detailed coloration and shading, and they are evenly spaced in a horizontal line across the composition.
title: Mortar and Pestles
